title: Submissions for 22nd Rádio MEC Award Close This Sunday
seoTitle: Rádio MEC Award Deadline Ends Sunday
subtitle: The competition accepts original works in Classical, Instrumental, and Children's Music categories
excerpt: The submission deadline for the 22nd Rádio MEC Award is this Sunday, the 13th. Works must be original, free of charge, and fit into three distinct musical categories.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The submission deadline for the 22nd Rádio MEC Award is this Sunday, the 13th. The competition is open to original musical works, distributed across three specific categories: Classical Music, Instrumental Music, and Children's Music.

How to Submit

Submissions are free, allowing composers and creators to present their works at no cost. To participate, interested parties must submit their compositions within the established period, which concludes this Sunday.

Competition Objective

The Rádio MEC Award aims to promote new musical productions, encouraging the creation of repertoire in classical, instrumental, and children's music genres.

With information from Agência Brasil.
